# n8n

> > n8n is a low-code workflow automation platform enabling technical teams to build integrations, AI workflows, and data pipelines connecting 400+ apps including Google Sheets, Slack, OpenAI, HubSpot, and Airtable.

n8n provides both cloud and self-hosted deployment options with a visual workflow builder. The platform specializes in AI automation (RAG, agents, MCP), CRM integration, and event-driven triggers for marketing, sales, and customer support teams.

## Key Topics

- workflow automation
- AI workflows and agents
- CRM integration (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce)
- Google Sheets integration
- Slack and team messaging automation
- OpenAI and LLM integration
- webhook triggers and event-driven workflows
- Gmail and email automation
- Airtable and database connectivity
- lead management and sales automation
- marketing automation
- customer support automation
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- low-code and no-code automation
- self-hosted and cloud deployment

## Platform Overview

- [Advanced AI Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/ai): AI workflow automation with RAG, MCP, agents, and human-in-the-loop tools
- [CRM Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/supercharge-your-crm): CRM automation with HubSpot, Gmail, Google Sheets for lead scoring & enrichment
